name: Dasa Koota (10 Poruthams)
citation: Kalaprakashika; Muhurtha Ratna; Tamil & Kannada Classical Jyotish Traditions
description: Traditional South Indian 10-fold matching system evaluating vital life dimensions with primary focus on Rajju and Vedha.

Shiro.name: Head (Shiro / Siras)
Shiro.impact: Endangers longevity of husband if same

Kantha.name: Neck (Kantha)
Kantha.impact: Endangers longevity of wife if same

Kati.name: Thigh / Hip (Kati)
Kati.impact: Causes financial distress / poverty if same

Pada.name: Foot (Pada)
Pada.impact: Causes aimless wandering / instability if same
